chunks: For those who fear their Lord in secret is forgiveness and a great reward.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who fear their Lord in secret?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse from Surah Mulk is often cited to emphasize that true piety (taqwa) is defined by internal sincerity rather than external performance, a concept central to the spiritual hierarchy of the Imams. It underscores the divine promise that God-consciousness in the unseen realm guarantees not only forgiveness but also a 'great reward' (ajr kabir), distinguishing the sincere believer from those whose faith is merely superficial.
